北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京寒意浓，体感-5℃，记得多穿暖和些哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very cold, feels like -5℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 10℃，出门记得添衣，注意保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Remember to add layers and stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海微凉 7℃，湿度较大，穿暖和别着凉啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cool at 7℃ with high humidity. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，22℃，体感舒适，户外活动很棒！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasant at 22℃. A great day for outdoor activities!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗宜人，22℃，体感舒适，享受好天气吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant at 22℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，出门注意防护，体感 11℃ 略凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has haze. Take precautions when going out. It feels a bit cool at 11℃.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低，体感 3℃，出行注意安全添衣。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with low visibility. Feels like 3℃, so stay safe and dress warmly.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 6℃，微凉，记得添件外套哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels cool at 6℃. Remember to grab a jacket!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉下雨又冷，体感 1℃。出门带伞，多穿保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is rainy and cold, feels like 1℃. Bring an umbrella and dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感 1℃ 湿度高，注意防湿防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cold, feels like 1℃ with high humidity. Protect yourself from dampness and cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，湿度大，体感 7℃。小心路滑，添衣保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and humid, feels like 7℃. Watch for slippery roads and dress warmly.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨-22℃ 极寒，请务必全副武装，注意防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold at -22℃. Please bundle up and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感-16℃，寒冷干燥，记得多喝水，注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -16℃, cold and dry. Remember to drink water and stay warm.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明舒适 20℃，体感 14℃ 稍凉，记得防晒，补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is pleasant at 20℃ but feels a bit cool at 14℃. Remember sunscreen and hydration.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天 18℃，体感 16℃，湿度大，记得带把伞。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy at 18℃, feels like 16℃, and humid. Remember to bring an umbrella.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感-1℃ 偏冷，出门务必多加衣，防止感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels cold at -1℃. Make sure to bundle up to avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连-14℃ 寒风凛冽，注意防风保暖，谨防冻伤。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is bitterly cold at -14℃ with strong winds. Guard against wind and cold, prevent frostbite.
